publicPolicy: Measurements and non-identifying classification only. Individual security judgments, evidence and attack preconditions are kept only in the internal archive outside Git.
note: Public derived follow-up summary. Exact baseline bytes/hash, scope patterns and internal commands are kept in the internal archive.

baseline.scope: four patterns explicitly excluded from route checks
baseline.caveat: complete means the reduced check scope ran; excluded routes and existing findings remain. Not a security pass.

syntheticGrowth.note: Synthetic client payload detection only. Not a real vulnerability, transfer-size or performance regression. The payload landed in a shared chunk, so all four measured pages increased by the same amount.

authHttp.note: The additional review item is not a confirmed vulnerability and is not detailed publicly.

limitations: Synthetic payload is a detection test, not a real-world degradation.
Scope exclusions mean coverage complete is not a full-scope pass.
Only Linux/WSL2 and one loopback server were tested.
No rate-limit, CSRF, CORS, privilege-escalation or expiry-boundary tests.
Install/build script pre-review records were not preserved; sufficiency is unverified.
